spec.description: Full-year season audit of the six region-type forts on v7.5 with the 13 Oct apex rules (biome additions, narrowed dingo, giant bug apexes, tigerfish/anaconda, nightwing, apex pack x1.5) and the ISOLATED extinct fix: good, evil, small-savage, untamed-wilds, joyous-wilds and terrifying forts (region16 = region10's terrain, region19), spring -> next spring +20,000 ticks, 1 replicate, DF restarted per fort. Measured as X4v75b, plus the savage/evil content: giants, animal people, extinct species, wired evil apexes, giant bug apexes on the map.

receipts.lua: local c = reqscript('seasonal-wildlife').loadConfig(); for _, r in ipairs(c.fp_created or {}) do local d = -1; if r.kind == 'cave' then d = df.global.world.world_data.underground_regions[r.cave].layer_depth end; print(('fp_created %s %s %d'):format(r.kind, r.token, d)) end; print('fp_created total ' .. #(c.fp_created or {}))
